civilian_work_femme · 8 frames of the cycle · human_femme / human_masc

walk cycle

Each limb group is rotated about its body pivot by rig_walk.json's swing; the clothing shares the group so it swings with the limb. Torso, head and arms ride a bob.

interior: concourse

The trade ring's public concourse: one wide hall with a docking bay off the east side. You enter from the west airlock, cross the hall past the central column, and pass through to the dock. A bench sits against the south wall.

floor plan · generated lanes (yellow) + placed hitboxes (green = declared blocker, magenta = clear, red = fault)

  • column at [180, 100]: on a lane, declared blocks_lane - ok
  • bench at [74, 192]: clear of lanes - ok

ship: courier

A blunt-nosed civilian courier — a stubby delta hull with a raised canopy blister forward and two outboard engine pods aft. Reads clean at a dozen pixels: a wide arrowhead with two bright dots for thrust.

size 11 · about 1.4x the player's own ship; ~15 m wingtip to wingtip.

near (all detail) · far (~13 px) · hitbox overlay · beside the player figure

station: trade_ring

A civilian trade ring — an octagonal hub on four spokes, each ending in a blocky docking pod, with a thin wheel rim linking the pods. A lit core at the centre. Reads at a distance as a bright-cored cross inside a ring.

size 46 · about 30x the player tall; you dock at one of the four pods.

near (all detail) · far (~13 px) · hitbox overlay · beside the player figure

set: civilian_summer_femme

tank_top_femme + skirt + shoes_femme + hair_short

set: civilian_summer_masc

Warm-weather civilian: knit tank, flared skirt, slip-on shoes. Masc-fitted equivalent of civilian_summer_femme.

set: civilian_work_femme

Everyday civilian: knit tank, denim trousers, slip-on shoes, long hair. Femme variant — see civilian_work_masc for the masc-fitted equivalent.
